reader_usefulness.location: Entire v3 report lines 1–278: retained-object definitions and loop (1–37), DGM/AlphaEvolve/Promptbreeder/SCoRe/HarnessPro (39–136), negative evidence and comparison (138–169), evaluator/exposure/economics (171–224), adoption and appendix (226–278).
reader_usefulness.basis: Read the complete original task, effective requirements and empty scope decisions, followed by every report line in continuous ranges 1–65, 66–130, 131–205 and 206–278. The opening provides a concrete organizing question—what later tasks inherit—and the first matrix identifies persistent objects before comparing scores. Individual loops explain external models, human-designed objectives, history, selection and deployment separately. DGM transfer is explicitly attributed to a combined tool and additional-inference implementation; AlphaEvolve local and system-wide gains use different denominators; SCoRe separates first/second-attempt gains from a changed correction delta. The negative harness study is kept distinct from HarnessPro in tasks, budget and selected-answer metrics. The comparison matrix and evaluator discussion let leaders decide which scope of generalization a result supports, and adoption guidance links editable interfaces, recurring failures, preserved properties and rollback to specific choices. Missing all-in costs and public optimizer access narrow the claims without erasing the documented gains. No required reader-understanding or decision-use defect found. Assessment uses the full supplied report and citation presentation; it does not claim fresh source verification or experimental replication.
